name: Do you also paint the repaired drywall, or just prepare it?

mainEntity.name: Do you also paint the repaired drywall, or just prepare it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our primary service for drywall repair focuses on preparing the surface to be paint-ready. This includes patching, taping, mudding, sanding smooth, and applying primer to ensure a consistent base. While our core offering concludes before final paint coats, we ensure the repaired area is perfectly primed and ready for your chosen finish. We always recommend applying a topcoat of paint across the entire wall to achieve the most uniform and seamless appearance after repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: We prepare and prime the repaired drywall, making it ready for painting, but do not typically apply the final paint coats.
